  inner join F_ARTICLE on F_DOCLIGNE.ar_ref=F_ARTICLE.ar_ref inner join F_FAMILLE on F_ARTICLE.FA_CodeFamille=F_FAMILLE.FA_CodeFamille WHERE DL_MvtStock IN (1,3) and DE_No in({in})
